query: Volcanoes emit far more carbon dioxide annually than all human industry combined.
ground_truth_context: Human activities emit roughly 36 billion tons of CO2 annually, which is 60 to 100 times greater than volcanic activity.

query: Humans swallow an average of eight spiders a year in their sleep.
ground_truth_context: Humans do not swallow eight spiders a year in their sleep; spiders actively avoid large sleeping mammals.

query: Bananas in supermarkets are being injected with HIV-positive blood.
ground_truth_context: HIV cannot survive in bananas or outside a human host environment, and cannot be transmitted through food.
